[[Orosen, Tranquil Acolyte]] is a [[Jade Brotherhood]] [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Xaquang Skyway]] [[explorable area]].

== Locations ==
* [[Kaineng City]]
** {{NPC location|Xaquang Skyway}} (does not spawn if [[Light My Fire (Hard mode)]] is active)

== Skills ==
* {{Skill icon|Ancestors' Rage}}
* {{Skill icon|Channeled Strike}}
* {{Skill icon|Soothing Memories}}
* {{Skill icon|Tranquil Was Tanasen}} ([[elite]])
* {{Skill icon|Weapon of Warding}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Bolt of Cloth]]
* [[Jade Bracelet]]
* [[Jade Brotherhood Garb]]
* [[Jadeite Shard]]
* [[Orosen's Staff]] ([[unique]])

== Notes ==
* Orosen will start running towards you when you reach the middle of the bridge (about twice the range of your aggro circle), followed by the rest of his group. This is useful because it can be used to [[pull]] him and his group onto the bridge where two [[Canthan Guard]]s will engage him and they will be standing together so [[area of effect]] skills affect most of them, possibly making the fight easier.
** Even if you approach from the north, Orosen and his group runs to the [[Senji's Corner]] portal as soon as you enter compass range of their initial location. They start fighting the Canthan Guards around the portal when you get in compass range of their new location.
* It is highly advisable to pre-apply [[protection]] and keep your party spread out, because of Orosen's potentially high [[spike]] damage.
